scanNote:
10-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (71-bet). Chap yarmi OCh KO'K fonda.

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Stick to the Rules!' va YaShIL yorliqda oq '10'.

CHAP USTUN:
• VARAQA (krem qog'oz, yirtiq chegara): qizil-jigarrang sarlavha 'Is Your Home A Safe Place For Your Kids?'. Qalin kirish: 'Every year, thousands of children are injured in accidents in the home - accidents that could be prevented. Read this leaflet and make sure that similar accidents don't happen to your children.' Yetti nuqtali band:
   • Keep all cleaning products in a safe place. Your children might drink them and poison themselves.
   • Always put knives and other sharp objects away after use. Your children could cut themselves.
   • Never allow your children to play with pots and pans on the stove. They could scald themselves.
   • Make sure you cover electrical sockets when they are not in use. Your children could give themselves an electric shock.
   • Never let your children play with matches. They might start a fire and burn themselves.
   • Fit safety gates at the top and bottom of the stairs. Your children could fall and hurt themselves.
   • Put a fence around any ponds or pools in your garden. Your children might fall in and drown.
   SURAT: jingalak sochli qizcha, qo'llari iyagida, kulmoqda.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development'.
4) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Qiya: electrical, cleaning, fire, gates, sharp, shock. 1 ... products 2 ... objects 3 ... sockets | 4 an electric ... 5 to start a(n) ... 6 safety ...
5) 'Fill in the correct word from the list below.' Qiya: burn, cut, drown, hurt, scald, poison. 1 The little boy ...... himself with the sharp knife. 2 Don't put your hand in hot water! You'll ...... yourself! 3 That isn't orange juice! Don't drink it! You might ...... yourself. 4 Kim fell over and ...... herself yesterday. 5 Don't touch the fire! You'll ...... yourself! 6 Don't go near the water! You might fall in and ......!

O'NG USTUN:
6) 'Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' 1 injured ..... accidents; 2 happen ..... sb; 3 keep sth ..... a safe place; 4 put sth ..... after use; 5 ..... the stove; 6 to be ..... use; 7 play ..... sth; 8 ..... the top/bottom ..... the stairs; 9 put a fence ..... sth
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Cover the leaflet in Ex. 3, then use the pictures on p. 70 to talk about the warnings and possible dangers.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Imperative'. OCh KO'K quti 'Use': 'We use the IMPERATIVE to tell people what to do/not to do. PUT a fence around any ponds in your garden. DON'T LET your children play with matches.'
7) 'Read the leaflet again and underline all the imperative forms.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Reflexive Pronouns'. OCh KO'K quti 'Use': 'We use reflexive pronouns when the subject and the object of the verb refer to the same person or thing. They might cut THEMSELVES.'
8) a) 'Fill in the missing pronouns from the list.' Qiya: myself, themselves, himself, yourselves, herself. JADVAL (yirtiq qog'oz): subject pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, you, they | reflexive pronouns: ......, yourself, ......, ......, itself, ourselves, ......, ......
   b) 'Fill in the correct reflexive pronoun, then act out the dialogues in pairs.' 1 A: Can I use the knife? B: No. You'll cut ...... . 2 A: What has he done? B: He's hurt ...... . 3 A: What's wrong? B: I've cut ...... . 4 A: Did they like the party? B: Yes, they enjoyed ...... . 5 A: Why is she crying? B: She's burnt ...... .

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '71'.

exercises.instructionEn: Is Your Home A Safe Place For Your Kids?
exercises.explanationUz:
XAVFSIZLIK VARAQASI - TO'LIQ MATNI
VA TARJIMASI.


⚠ TUZILIShI:

  Har band = BUYRUQ (imperative) +
  SABAB (might/could + natija).


⚠ 10-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI:

  BUYRUQ MAYLI: Keep, put, Never
     allow, Make sure, Never let,
     Fit, Put
  MODAL FE'LLAR: might, could
  O'ZLIK OLMOShLARI: themselves
  MAJHUL: 'are injured', 'could be
     prevented'

points.en: Every year, thousands of children are injured in accidents in the home - accidents that could be prevented. Read this leaflet and make sure that similar accidents don't happen to your children.
points.uz: Har yili minglab bolalar uydagi baxtsiz hodisalarda jarohatlanadi - bu hodisalarning oldini olish mumkin edi. Bu varaqani o'qing va shunga o'xshash hodisalar bolalaringiz bilan sodir bo'lmasligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'are injured', 'could be prevented' -
majhul nisbat.
⚠ 'to happen TO sb' = kimdir bilan sodir
bo'lmoq.

points.en: Keep all cleaning products in a safe place. Your children might drink them and poison themselves.
points.uz: Barcha tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlang. Bolalaringiz ularni ichib zaharlanishi mumkin.

points.en: Always put knives and other sharp objects away after use. Your children could cut themselves.
points.uz: Pichoq va boshqa o'tkir narsalarni ishlatgandan keyin har doim joyiga qo'ying. Bolalaringiz o'zini kesib olishi mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'put ... away' = joyiga qo'ymoq.
⚠ 'after use' = ishlatgandan keyin.

points.en: Never allow your children to play with pots and pans on the stove. They could scald themselves.
points.uz: Bolalaringizga plitadagi qozon-tovalar bilan o'ynashga hech qachon ruxsat bermang. Ular o'zini kuydirib olishi mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'allow sb TO do'.
⚠ 'scald' = qaynoq suyuqlik bilan kuymoq.

points.en: Make sure you cover electrical sockets when they are not in use. Your children could give themselves an electric shock.
points.uz: Rozetkalar ishlatilmayotganda ularni yopganingizga ishonch hosil qiling. Bolalaringizni tok urishi mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'give themselves an electric shock' =
o'zini tok urdirmoq.

points.en: Never let your children play with matches. They might start a fire and burn themselves.
points.uz: Bolalaringizni hech qachon gugurt bilan o'ynashga qo'ymang. Ular yong'in chiqarib o'zini kuydirib olishi mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'let sb do' - 'to' siz.
⚠ 'to start a fire' = yong'in chiqarmoq.

points.en: Fit safety gates at the top and bottom of the stairs. Your children could fall and hurt themselves.
points.uz: Zinaning yuqori va pastki qismiga xavfsizlik to'siqlarini o'rnating. Bolalaringiz yiqilib jarohatlanishi mumkin.

points.en: Put a fence around any ponds or pools in your garden. Your children might fall in and drown.
points.uz: Bog'ingizdagi har qanday hovuz yoki basseyn atrofiga panjara qo'ying. Bolalaringiz tushib ketib cho'kishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
VARAQADAGI IBORALAR:

  CLEANING products - tozalash
     vositalari
  SHARP objects - o'tkir narsalar
  ELECTRICAL sockets - rozetkalar
  an electric SHOCK - tok urishi
  to start a FIRE - yong'in
     chiqarmoq
  safety GATES - xavfsizlik
     to'siqlari


⚠ 'ELECTRIC' va 'ELECTRICAL':

  electric shock, electric light
  (bevosita elektr)
  electrical sockets, electrical
  equipment (elektrga oid)
  ⚠ Kitobda ikkalasi ham bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word from the list below.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAROHAT FE'LLARI:

  1 The little boy CUT himself with
    the sharp knife.
  2 You'll SCALD yourself! (hot
    water)
  3 You might POISON yourself.
    (not juice)
  4 Kim fell over and HURT herself.
  5 You'll BURN yourself! (fire)
  6 You might fall in and DROWN!
    (water)


⚠ 1-BAND - 'CUT' O'TGAN ZAMON:

  'The little boy CUT himself' -
  cut - cut - cut, 'yesterday' kabi
  vaqt bo'lmasa ham, hikoya
  o'tgan zamonda.


⚠ 6-BAND - O'ZLIK OLMOShISIZ:

  'drown' - o'zlik olmoshisiz
  ishlatiladi: 'You might drown'
  ('drown yourself' EMAS).


⚠ 'TO FALL OVER':

  = yiqilib tushmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predloglarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - VARAQADAN:

  injured IN accidents
  happen TO sb
  keep sth IN a safe place
  put sth AWAY after use
  ON the stove
  to be IN use
  play WITH sth
  AT the top/bottom OF the stairs
  put a fence AROUND sth


⚠ 'TO HAPPEN TO SB':

  = kimdir bilan sodir bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'What happened TO you?' = senga
  nima bo'ldi?


⚠ 'ON THE STOVE':

  = plita ustida.

exercises.explanationUz:
BUYRUQ MAYLI (THE IMPERATIVE).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ: fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
     (ega YO'Q):
     'Put a fence around any ponds.'
     'Keep cleaning products in a
      safe place.'

  INKOR: DON'T + fe'l:
     "Don't let your children play
      with matches."
  ⚠ 'NEVER' + fe'l - kuchli inkor:
     'Never allow ...'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Odamlarga NIMA QILISh / QILMASLIKNI
  aytish: buyruq, ko'rsatma,
  ogohlantirish, maslahat, taklif.

  ⚠ 'Please' bilan muloyimroq:
  'Please close the door.'


⚠ 'YOU' AYTILMAYDI:

  ✗ 'You put a fence.'
  ✓ 'Put a fence.'


⚠ 'ALWAYS' va 'NEVER' BILAN:

  'ALWAYS put knives away.'
  'NEVER let children play with
   matches.'

points.en: We use the imperative to tell people what to do/not to do.
points.uz: Buyruq maylini odamlarga nima qilish/qilmaslikni aytish uchun ishlatamiz.

points.en: Put a fence around any ponds in your garden.
points.uz: Bog'ingizdagi har qanday hovuz atrofiga panjara qo'ying.

points.en: Don't let your children play with matches.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the leaflet again and underline all the imperative forms.
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqani qayta o'qing va barcha buyruq mayli shakllari tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
VARAQADAGI BUYRUQ ShAKLLARI:

  Read this leaflet
  make sure
  Keep all cleaning products
  Always put knives ... away
  Never allow your children
  Make sure you cover
  Never let your children play
  Fit safety gates
  Put a fence

  ⚠ To'qqizta buyruq.
  ⚠ 'Never allow', 'Never let' -
  inkor buyruqlar.

points.en: Read, make sure, Keep, put (away), Never allow, Make sure, Never let, Fit, Put
points.uz: Read, make sure, Keep, put (away), Never allow, Make sure, Never let, Fit, Put

exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZLIK OLMOShLARI (REFLEXIVE
PRONOUNS).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLLARI                       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I     → myself
  you   → yourself (birlik)
  he    → himself
  she   → herself
  it    → itself
  we    → ourselves
  you   → yourselves (ko'plik)
  they  → themselves

  ⚠ Birlik '-self', ko'plik
  '-selves'.
  ⚠ 'hisself', 'theirselves' - XATO!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  EGA va TO'LDIRUVChI BIR ODAM/NARSA
  bo'lganda:

  'They might cut THEMSELVES.'
  (ular o'zlarini kesadi)

  ⚠ Taqqoslang:
  'He hurt HIMSELF.' - o'zini
  'He hurt HIM.' - boshqa odamni


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  'o'zim, o'zing, o'zi, o'zimiz,
  o'zingiz, o'zlari'.


⚠ 'ENJOY YOURSELF':

  = yaxshi dam olmoq, zavqlanmoq.
  ⚠ 'enjoy' dan keyin to'ldiruvchi
  ShART: 'They enjoyed themselves.'

points.en: We use reflexive pronouns when the subject and the object of the verb refer to the same person or thing.
points.uz: O'zlik olmoshlarini fe'lning egasi va to'ldiruvchisi bir odam yoki narsaga tegishli bo'lganda ishlatamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing pronouns from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL:

  I → MYSELF
  you → yourself
  he → HIMSELF
  she → HERSELF
  it → itself
  we → ourselves
  you → YOURSELVES
  they → THEMSELVES

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct reflexive pronoun, then act out the dialogues in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri o'zlik olmoshini qo'ying, so'ng juftlikda dialoglarni o'ynang.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 You'll cut YOURSELF.
  2 He's hurt HIMSELF.
  3 I've cut MYSELF.
  4 They enjoyed THEMSELVES.
  5 She's burnt HERSELF.


⚠ EGAGA QARANG:

  You → yourself
  He → himself
  I → myself
  they → themselves
  She → herself


⚠ 4-BAND:

  'enjoyed THEMSELVES' = yaxshi
  dam olishdi.

items.whyUz:
⚠ they → THEMSELVES.
⚠ 'enjoy themselves' = yaxshi dam olmoq.
